system.description:
Your magic comes from a moment of fey contact — a bargain half-remembered, a dream that lasted too long.

  • Bloodline Ability (1st): Once per encounter, teleport up to 30ft to any visible unoccupied space as part of your movement. You have advantage on saves vs charm and sleep, and creatures cannot magically compel you to reveal information you choose to withhold.
  • Bloodline Awakening (15th): Once per day, for 1 minute all saves against your spells are made at disadvantage within 60ft. Once on each of your turns during this window, when a creature fails a save against a spell you cast, you may cast one additional spell of 5th level or lower targeting that creature as part of the same action, expending its slot; this additional spell cannot trigger this ability.
